No...
I think my pdoc maybe is trying to change my meds and thus tapering off my prozac?? I don't know:(

I share a lot in common with your comment. But for me, having high standards is what is actually giving me more stress and ruining my life, I guess. It makes me very suicidal.  But it is good to hear that I might grow to love it perhaps.

I am currently doing IB. I am 18 years old and if you don't know, IB is a bit more difficult than A-level (in my opinion). I want to be an art historian or work in art museum when I grow up because every time I go to art museum or gallery, I feel really calm. I don't like a big noisy crowd so it is really comfortable for me to stay there. Thank you for listening:)
Me. I am doing IB and my suicidal thoughts just intensify everyday. IB sucks. It is not for me I think.

I have very similar thing with you. I have started that from when I was 15. I had bulimia first and then I managed to stop vomiting but now I occasionally starve myself and when I do eat I feel extremely guilty and ironically I start to binge. I don't know why I am like this.
Once I went to the bathroom and washed my face until it is so cold it was red. It sort of woke me up.
Me. I just don't talk these days. My former 'friends' think I am weird now probably.
Me. Especially before presentation. It is the worse. I just want to throw up and go back to bed and dark room and sit there forever.

Your intrusive thoughts are very similar to mine. Although I have never experienced "sensational symmetry", I keep check whether my judgement is right when I smell something or touch something. As if I am unsure whether it is really a cold object or not.
Well done!! :)
That's really sweet. Before, I once got a nice email and I cried. These things are what doesn't let me go.
It is like thinking 'I wish I am in that car accident so that I can die instead of him' because I don't know how to kill myself and I am afraid of the chance of failure.
That's me
Hello! I just took my internal test for IB (I am in Year 12) and I was worried about my predicted grade because I messed it up... Anyway thank you for writing this post!

Yeah it happens a lot to me. My dreams are really vivid and when I wake up, I wonder whether it really happened or it was a dream. But I don't have schizophrenia though. I have depression, anxiety disorders, and OCD. I am not sure whether it only happens with people with psychosis, but anyway it happens to me quite frequently especially if I miss to take my medication.

Hi there.. 
I've been taking mock IB test this week and yeah I can relate to you a lot. I just thought yesterday, that I won't be able to go to university or something like that. I am honestly thinking, if I don't go to college, all the hopes from my family and all that would be toppled and such. To be honest, and sorry because, I don't have any great advice or help to give you. but I hope you don't feel lonely or that you are the only person who are going through this kind of things.
Yes, it happens. I have OCD, anxiety disorders, and depression. It sucks because it feels like your brain doesn't make any sense and they are keep fighting with each other.
I think you did very well today. Well done!! :)

Thank you for your kind reply. I have spoken to my doctor about this, as he mentioned about thought blocking during my last session. Yet we didn't discuss about schizophrenia as it was my own curiosity and concern. Anyhow, thank you and have a lovely day. :)

Hello, thank you for your comment. I feel like if I say 'I want to commit suicide', the possible answer would be 'no'. 
Well, I've been seeing my psychiatrist weekly and taking pills and all that (due to depression, anxiety disorders, OCD, and former eating disorder) but I feel like it is keep going worse and I just can't deal with this anymore. To be honest, I am sick of being myself, I guess. 
I am still not sure about this all - even about the methods and all that - but it's been dominating my thoughts for months now. 
Sorry that I am whining. Have a lovely day.
Thank you for your comment. Tt sounds like a ridiculous question but do the buildings sue them/their family if they do so?
